meaning_en: Causing shock or dismay; dreadful.
example_en: The living conditions in the refugee camp were appalling.
examples_extra: The service at the hotel was appalling.
They live in appalling conditions.

meaning_en: A general overview without specific details.
example_en: The report provided a broad summary of the findings.
examples_extra: She gave a broad summary of the report.
The article offers a broad summary of events.

meaning_en: To visit and explore a website.
example_en: You should check out their website for more information.
examples_extra: Check out our website today.
She checked out the new website.
note_fa: سری به سایت زدن؛ check out + سایت.

meaning_en: To select a link or button on a website.
example_en: You need to click on a website link to proceed.
examples_extra: Click on the link at the top of the website.
Visitors can click on the banner to learn more.

meaning_en: Extremely unpleasant or offensive.
example_en: The smell from the garbage was absolutely disgusting.
examples_extra: The rotten smell was absolutely disgusting today.
His table manners are truly disgusting, honestly.

meaning_en: Causing gloom or dejection; dreary.
example_en: The weather was dismal, with constant rain and grey skies.
examples_extra: The exam results were truly dismal this year.
It was a cold, dismal winter day.

meaning_en: Unpleasant or offensive to one's taste or moral sense.
example_en: The comedian's jokes were often quite distasteful.
examples_extra: He made a crude, distasteful joke at dinner.
The film's graphic violence was truly distasteful indeed.

meaning_en: Not true or real; incorrect.
example_en: The witness gave a false statement to the police.
examples_extra: The rumour turned out to be false.
He gave a false name to the police.

meaning_en: Silly and pointless; foolish.
example_en: His fatuous remarks annoyed everyone at the meeting.
examples_extra: He made a fatuous remark and laughed.
The article was full of fatuous claims.

meaning_en: To have a very firm opinion or belief.
example_en: I feel strongly that education is a fundamental right.
examples_extra: She feels strongly about education.
They feel strongly that change is needed.

meaning_en: Inspiring fear or respect due to size or power.
example_en: The team faced a formidable opponent in the final.
examples_extra: She is a formidable opponent.
The task seemed quite formidable.

meaning_en: The real, authentic thing; not a copy.
example_en: This antique vase is the genuine article.
examples_extra: This watch is the genuine article.
He's the genuine article, a true friend.

meaning_en: Navigate to a specific internet address.
example_en: Please go to our website for more information.
examples_extra: Go to our website for details.
Go to the website to register.

meaning_en: Including many specific facts and information.
example_en: She described the incident in great detail to the police.
examples_extra: She described it in great detail.
Tell me in great detail.
note_fa: یعنی «با جزئیات فراوان»؛ in big detail غلط است.

meaning_en: Unable to find one's way or direction.
example_en: We got lost in the dense forest.
examples_extra: The lost child was soon found by police.
We got completely lost in the old town.

meaning_en: Extremely foolish, unreasonable, or out of place.
example_en: The idea of flying to the moon in a cardboard box is ludicrous.
examples_extra: His strange proposal was dismissed as utterly ludicrous.
It seems utterly ludicrous to blame the weather.

meaning_en: Someone who competes against or opposes another.
example_en: He defeated his opponent in the final round.
examples_extra: He beat his strong opponent.
She respects every single opponent.

meaning_en: Having no purpose or meaning; useless.
example_en: Arguing further seemed utterly pointless.
examples_extra: Honestly, it's pointless to argue now.
The long meeting felt completely pointless.

meaning_en: Bring up children.
meaning_fa: خانواده تشکیل دادن، فرزند بزرگ کردن
example_en: They decided to move to the suburbs to raise a family.
examples_extra: They raised a family in Toronto.
She raised three children completely alone.
note_fa: بچه بزرگ کردن؛ raise a family.

meaning_en: Lift your hand to ask a question or vote.
example_en: Please raise your hand if you have any questions.
examples_extra: Raise your hand to answer.
Half the class raised their hands.

meaning_en: An authentic or genuine example of something.
example_en: This isn't a replica; it's the real thing.
examples_extra: This is the real thing.
She wanted the real thing, not a copy.

meaning_en: Recall something correctly.
example_en: If I remember rightly, the meeting is at 3 PM.
examples_extra: If I remember rightly, she left.
You were there, if I remember rightly.

meaning_en: the general opinion people have about someone or something
example_en: The company has a strong reputation for quality products.
examples_extra: She has a good reputation.
The school's reputation is truly excellent.

meaning_en: extremely silly or unreasonable, deserving laughter
example_en: That's a ridiculous idea; it will never work.
examples_extra: That is the most ridiculous excuse ever.
The hotel prices here are simply ridiculous.

meaning_en: Very quickly and promptly.
example_en: The police swiftly apprehended the suspect.
examples_extra: She swiftly finished the task.
The storm moved swiftly across the coast.

meaning_en: Assign a task to someone.
example_en: The committee was tasked with finding a solution.
examples_extra: She tasked him with the report.
He was tasked to organise the event.

meaning_en: To go to a website on the internet.
example_en: Please visit our website for more information.
examples_extra: Visit our website for details.
She visits the website daily.

meaning_en: incorrect or not right.
example_en: You got the answer wrong; try again.
examples_extra: Your answer is completely wrong.
She accidentally took the wrong bus.
